title: Thai Cave Rescue Mission
description: In June-July 2018, twelve members of a youth soccer team and their coach were trapped in the Tham Luang cave system in northern Thailand by rising floodwaters. The boys, aged 11-16, survived for nine days before being discovered by British divers. Their rescue became a global news story, involving over 10,000 people including international cave diving experts, Thai Navy SEALs, and volunteers. After a complex 17-day operation involving sedation and underwater extraction, all 13 were successfully rescued, though one Thai Navy SEAL diver tragically died during the mission.
